name: Calendar
purpose: Inline single, range, or multiple date selection.
useWhen: Inline single, range, or multiple date selection.

avoidWhen.condition: Scheduling, recurrence or remote business availability is required.

composition: Calendar.Root size accepts 2xs, xs, sm, md, lg, xl or 2xl. Explicit size wins over the compatibility density prop: compact defaults to sm, comfortable to md. Cells remain square and shrink within narrow hosts; size does not change selection behavior.

Use Calendar.Root with a stable referenceDate and an accessible name. Root (div), Header (div), PrevTrigger/NextTrigger/ViewTrigger (buttons), Grid (table), MonthSelect/YearSelect (select), Context (render function). Default children provide navigation and all requested month grids. Day buttons remain native buttons within the grid.
Use date-value helpers without converting date-only values to UTC midnight.

rules.statement: Keep date behavior in Atom and presentation in Brick. Do not duplicate popup engines or replace semantic segments with text inputs.
Load styles.css or core.css plus styles/calendar.css. Use documented visual props and locale overrides.

commonMistakes.mistake: Inventing current dates during hydration or submitting localized strings.
commonMistakes.correction: Supply stable referenceDate and typed values; preserve canonical form mirrors.

validation: Verify keyboard, locale/RTL, constraints, reset, narrow width, appearance and forced colors.
